skills.name: ESP
skills.description: Detects psychic power and enhances physical ability.

skills.name: Judgment
skills.description: Deals the strongest possible fatal blow using righteous judgment.

skills.name: Follow the Lead
skills.description: Allows one to lead up to 3 pets at once. (Passive skill)

skills.name: Visitor Melee Attack
skills.description: Visitor Melee Attack

skills.name: Psychic Attack
skills.description: Attack enemies in front of you with psychokinesis. Can be used by pressing the attack key.

skills.name: Return
skills.description: Returns you to Kinesis's Hideout.

skills.name: Defend
skills.description: Surrounds your body with a shield of pure psychokinetic energy to defend against enemy attacks. Also increases Stamina.

skills.name: Mental Fortitude
skills.description: Embeds psychokinetic energy at a cellular level to strengthen you.

skills.name: Psychic Force
skills.description: Knock enemies back with psychokinesis. Use it with the down key to knock enemies downward. Can be resisted by some enemies.

skills.name: Psychic Force
skills.description: Strikes an enemy twice with the power of psychokinesis.
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: ESP Booster
skills.description: Temporarily increases your Attack Speed.

skills.name: Kinetic Step
skills.description: Leap once more while already in the air. Can be used twice. Press the up key at the same time to move upward.

skills.name: Kinetic Step
skills.description: Moves Kinesis with the power of psychokinesis. Can jump twice when used while jumping, and can move up when pressing the up key. Movement distance increases with skill level.
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: Ultimate: Pressure
skills.description:
Warp space with powerful psychokinesis to create micro black holes.
The micro black hole is unaffected by attack reflection and is created nearest to the boss with the highest Max HP.
Micro Black Hole's cooldown is unaffected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: ESP Mastery
skills.description: Hones your Psy-limiter through intense training.

skills.name: Pure Power
skills.description: The pure force of psychokinesis brings you to new heights.

skills.name: Mental Strength
skills.description: Embeds psychokinetic energy at a cellular level to strengthen you further.

skills.name: Psychic Rise
skills.description: Slams enemies upwards into a field of high-density psychokinesis.

skills.name: Psychic Sprint
skills.description: Charge forward quickly by propelling yourself with psychokinesis.

skills.name: Kinetic Combo
skills.description:
Upon landing a direct attack skill, condensed energy explodes, causing an additional attack.
Kinetic Combo targets the boss with the highest HP within range first. Unaffected by attack reflection.

skills.name: Psychic Reinforcement
skills.description: Clear your mind to maintain razor-sharp concentration during battle.

skills.name: Transcendence
skills.description: Use your supernatural abilities to transcend your physical limitations.

skills.name: Mitigation
skills.description: Surround your body with a pocket of controlled psychokinetic energy to enhance your resistance to attacks.

skills.name: Psychic Fall
skills.description: With the power of psychokinesis, instantly lift an enemy into the air, then slam them to the ground with great force.

skills.name: Ultimate: Opening
skills.description:
Increase gravitational forces around an enemy as a strategic opening move.
Inflicts a debuff on the enemy with the highest Max HP within range. A powerful gravitational field forms around debuffed enemies, pulling surrounding objects toward them to attack.
All attacks except for Ultimate: Opening's first attack are unaffected by attack reflection. Unaffected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Ultimate: Opening
skills.description:
Lifts enemies or objects with the power of psychokinesis. You cannot lift bosses, stationary monsters, or enemies 11+ levels higher than you. The following actions can be done while holding:
\c
\c[Psychic Smash]: Using [Psychic Grab] while an enemy is lifted up will throw them at other nearby enemies, dealing damage.
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: Ultimate: Opening
skills.note: Invisible in the skillbook UI.

skills.name: Kinetic Jaunt
skills.description:
Walk on air by using psychokinetic waves to support yourself. You can move in five directions by combining the left, right, and up arrow keys. While no arrow keys are pressed, you will hover in place.
Unaffected by cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Warp
skills.description: Gather a mass of psychokinetic energy, then condense it to fold the space around you, teleporting you instantly from one point to another.

skills.name: ESP Expert
skills.description: Master the use of psychokinesis through the Psy-limiter.

skills.name: Awakening
skills.description: Awakens your psychic abilities fully.

skills.name: Concentration
skills.description: Focuses your mind fully so you can carry out more efficient attacks.

skills.name: Critical Rush
skills.description: Push your abilities to the absolute limit, just shy of the breaking point.

skills.name: Psychic Smash - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Psychic Smash.

skills.name: Psychic Smash - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases the Ignore Defense of Psychic Smash.

skills.name: Psychic Smash - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate of Psychic Smash.

skills.name: Ultimate - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Ultimate skills.

skills.name: Ultimate - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases Ignore Defense of Ultimate skills.

skills.name: Ultimate - Boss Rush
skills.description: Increases Boss Damage of Ultimate skills.

skills.name: Kinetic Combo - Reinforce
skills.description: Increases the damage of Kinetic Combo.

skills.name: Kinetic Combo - Guardbreak
skills.description: Increases the Ignore Defense of Kinetic Combo.

skills.name: Kinetic Combo - Critical Chance
skills.description: Increases Critical Rate of Kinetic Combo.

skills.name: Psychic Smash
skills.description: Lifts an Otherworld object and slams it down toward the enemy.

skills.name: Ultimate: Gambit
skills.description:
Crashes an empty train into an enemy at high speed.
Unaffected by attack reflection or cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Ultimate: Check
skills.description:
Create orbs of psychokinetic energy and launch them at an enemy to drive them to a vulnerable position.
Unaffected by attack reflection or cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Breakthrough
skills.description:
Temporarily disables the Psy-limiter to unleash an outpouring of pent-up psychokinetic energy. This excess of energy significantly increases the power of your Ultimate skills.
Unaffected by buff duration increase and cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: President's Orders
skills.description: The Goddess of the Otherworld's protection increases your stats. Using the skill briefly makes the Goddess of the Otherworld appear.

skills.name: Clear Mind
skills.description:
Clear your mind to ignore certain abnormal status effects. Immune to most abnormal status effects for 3 sec after use. Certain abnormal status effects will still get through.
Clear Mind can be used while other skills are active. Additionally, permanently increases Status Resistance.

skills.name: Mental Tempest
skills.description: Generates a powerful wave of psychokinetic energy, which allows you to temporarily ignore all damage.

skills.name: Mental Overdrive
skills.description: Tweak gravity to increase oxygen flow to the mind, maximizing your inner psychic power.

skills.name: Mental Shock
skills.description: Draw forth the deepest fears from the depths of your enemies' minds, stunning them.

skills.name: Psychic Shockwave
skills.description: Read the flow of particles and send out a pulse to rip through the flow.
skills.note: 1 frame(s) could not be downloaded: the source serves corrupted data for them: effect2-07.png.

skills.name: Psychic Nova
skills.description:
Summon a giant Otherworld object, then compress it until it explodes. The powerful wave of mental energy released damages enemies.
Unaffected by attack reflection.
skills.note: 2 frame(s) could not be downloaded: the source serves corrupted data for them: effect-28.png, effect-38.png. 11 effect-flash frame(s) have no image data in the source (parametric flash, not sprites).

skills.name: Ultimate: Checkmate
skills.description:
Launch Otherworld objects at enemies from unpredictable angles. The procession of moves is flawless.
Prioritizes the boss with the highest Max HP. Unaffected by attack reflection or cooldown reset effects.

skills.name: Psychic Castle
skills.description:
Dominate the enemy's mind to create a giant game of chess.
The game opens by designating a king. During the match, pincers will occasionally trigger. Upon landing enough active Ultimate skills or From Another Realm, the game ends and the king deals an additional attack.
Prioritizes the boss with the highest Max HP. Unaffected by attack reflection.
Right-click to toggle the background on/off.

skills.name: From Another Realm
skills.description:
Drops matter from the Otherworld through a spatial rift to devastate the landscape.
While Breakthrough is active, power is greatly enhanced.

Lv. 10: Ignore Defense +20%
Lv. 20: Boss Damage +20%
Lv. 30: Ignore Defense +30% and Boss Damage +30%

skills.name: Fractal Horizon
skills.description:
Unleashes endlessly duplicating matter from the Otherworld to ensnare an area in a unbreakable fractal structure.

Lv. 10 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 20 - Ignore Defense: +10%, Boss Damage: +10%
Lv. 30 - Ignore Defense: +20%
